title: Momcozy BM04 Smart WiFi Baby Monitor with 2 Cameras, 5" 1080P Split Screen
bullets: 【Watch 2 Rooms at Once on a Single 5" Split Screen】 This innovative baby monitor system allows you to connect 2 cameras and view both feeds simultaneously on one 5-inch large split screen. With parent unit, you can watch both video feeds side by side—no need to switch back and forth. Ideal for keeping an eye on twins, siblings in separate rooms, or a nursery and play area. Supports up to 4 camera connections for peace of mind.

【Flexible Monitoring: Parent Unit & WiFi Connection】 Stay connected with your baby no matter where you are. Choose the non-WiFi parent unit for secure, real-time monitoring at home, or use the Momcozy App to check the live feed on the go. With advanced encryption technology, your baby’s video remains private and protected, giving you peace of mind while staying close to what matters most. Note: Pairing via Wi-Fi supports only 2.4GHz Wi-Fi networks.

【Superior Night Vision for Peaceful Nights】 Keep watch over your little one even in complete darkness. Equipped with 2 cameras and a split-screen display, the baby monitor's screen delivers clear, detailed night vision—so you never miss a movement, even while they sleep soundly.

【Comfort Your Baby with Clear 2-Way Audio】 Sooth your child from any where. The high-sensitivity microphone picks up subtle sounds, while the built-in speaker lets you speak directly and reassuringly to your baby through the parent unit or your phone, strengthening your bond even from a distance.

【Shared Video Access to Strengthen Family Connections】 Keep grandparents, relatives, and loved ones close—no matter the distance. With support for up to 20 shared users, the Momcozy baby monitor lets your family watch the baby’s precious moments and milestones together, creating lasting bonds from anywhere.

TIPS: Smart Baby Monitor Installation Guidelines: 1) Crib Mounting Height Requirement: Ensure the camera is positioned at least 0.6m (24 inches) above the baby. If placed too low, the camera’s focal length may misalign, causing a blurry image. 2) Wall or Floor Stand Mounting Distance Limit: Keep the camera within 5m (16 feet) of the crib horizontally. Beyond this range, the infrared night vision won’t provide sufficient lighting, making it difficult to see the baby’s face clearly in the dark.
